output.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] says the `istiod-remote` chart was removed. [ev-5a31c0781dc5] says it was merged into the regular `istio-discovery`/`istiod` chart, so remote clusters must now be installed with `--set profile=remote`, and the `istio-base` chart is now required in remote clusters too. Because the chart no longer exists in 1.24.0, an operator who does nothing cannot move to 1.24.0 on it, so migration-required (mandatory work) is the right kind. The proposed statement is wrong in saying the migration must happen "before upgrading": the evidence makes the chart switch part of the upgrade itself, and the statement also leaves out the istio-base requirement.

correction.statement: In 1.24.0 the istiod-remote Helm chart is removed and merged into the istio-discovery (istiod) chart. Remote-cluster installs that use istiod-remote must switch to the istiod chart with --set profile=remote, and must also install istio-base.

consequence.statement: The istiod-remote chart no longer exists in 1.24.0. Helm installs of remote clusters that use `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote` cannot move to 1.24.0 on that chart; they must switch to the istio-discovery/istiod chart with `--set profile=remote`. The istio-base chart is also now required in remote clusters.
consequence.remediation: Install or upgrade remote clusters with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` instead of the istiod-remote chart, and make sure the istio-base chart is installed in the remote cluster.
